assets.name: shop
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished, minimal mobile game navigation icon, isolated on a genuinely transparent background. Style: cozy botanical fantasy, smooth matte 3D game inventory render, softly rounded sculpted shapes, subtle faceted planes, warm diffuse upper-left light, restrained cream parchment / sage / deep forest green / warm honey gold / walnut palette. Match a floating-island forest game whose existing currency icons are matte gold coins and soft 3D butterflies. Very readable at 28–32 screen pixels. One strong silhouette with at most two simple decorative details. Front three-quarter view, centered, fills about 85 percent of square canvas, no clipping. No text, letters, numbers, notification badges, tile, frame, circular backing, background panel, floor plane, ground shadow, sparkles or scenery. No black cartoon outline. The UI will overlay its own tiny live text label at the lower edge, so keep the lower silhouette quiet. Subject: a tiny woodland market shopping bag, warm ochre canvas with short walnut handles and one simple deep green embossed leaf on its front. Clearly a shopping bag, not a money sack.
